claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: For two point surgeries x,y of a bent k-bit sign, the quadratic upper-cap interaction is C_R(S)=8 sigma 2^{-k}2^{-|S|}1_{R subset S}, where R=supp(x xor y) and sigma=g(x)g(y)(-1)^{|R|}.
claims.quantifiers: Every even k>=2, every bent Boolean g, and every distinct x,y.
limitations: This is one quadratic component of the complete coherent selector charge.

claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: The difference-spectrum upper-set packet is subadditive with exact refund rho=4delta for Hamming distance one and rho=8delta-2^{4-r}delta 1_{sigma=1} for r>=2. Hence 4delta<=rho<=8delta, and rho dominates the complete flat-law first variation 8delta2^{-r} of the cross-cap.
claims.quantifiers: Every even k>=2, every bent Boolean g, every distinct x,y, all Hamming distances 1<=r<=k, and both possible phase signs.
limitations: Does not yet bound the nonlinear coherent empty-control and retained-child residual.
Does not provide a no-double-spend rule for three or more displacement filters.

claims.label: EXACT_CORROBORATION
claims.statement: Exact rational verification passed 2,188,285 assertions across 2,305 point pairs through k=12.

claims.label: OPEN
claims.statement: No universal GU' estimate, full FEI proof, or genuine Boolean counterfamily with unbounded H/I is established.
